STEP 3 — OWNER BRANCH CUTOVER
- Change GitHub default branch
- Rename recovered branch to main
- Verify fresh clone of main
- Do not deploy yet,STEP 4 — RENDER CUTOVER
- Rebind Render to new main
- Clear build cache
- Deploy
- Verify GitHub SHA = Render SHA = /health SHA, STEP 5 — CI AND TESTS
- Run clean clone
- TypeScript
- Lint
- Backend tests
- Expo tests
- Secret scan
- Stop and report failures
